title: Uniform sign probabilities
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $f\colon\Omega\to\{−1,1\}$. Under the uniform distribution on $\Omega$, the probabilities that $f$ equals $1$ and $−1$ sum to $1$.
